name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (MNDA) for protecting confidential information shared between two parties.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Cloud Service Agreement for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Design Partner Agreement for giving early customers access to a product in exchange for feedback.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Common Paper Service Level Agreement, designed to be used alongside the Cloud Service Agreement to set uptime and support response targets.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Professional Services Agreement for engaging a provider to perform services described in a Statement of Work.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Common Paper Data Processing Agreement governing the processing of personal data between a controller/processor and a processor/subprocessor.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Software License Agreement for licensing on-premises or client-side software.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Partnership Agreement for business partnerships involving cooperation and trademark licensing between two companies.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Business Associate Agreement (BAA) for HIPAA-covered entities and their business associates handling protected health information.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Common Paper standard Pilot Agreement for a short-term trial or evaluation of a product or service before a longer-term commercial agreement.

name: AI Addendum
description: Common Paper standard AI Addendum supplementing a core agreement with terms governing the use of AI services, including model training and output ownership.
